Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made the first critical mistake in Step 4 when it incorrectly identified the page as the "Retail Postage Price Calculator" after clicking "Calculate a Price" on a search results page. The actual USPS International Shipping Calculator requires specific international fields (destination country, weight, dimensions) that were not present on the domestic calculator page the agent navigated to. This fundamental navigation error prevented the agent from ever being able to input the required details for an international shipment to Colombia, leading to a complete failure to retrieve the USPS rate. Subsequent steps were attempts to recover from this initial misidentification of the correct tool.
